name: 64152 · Parkville, MO
findings: ZIP 64152 (Parkville) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64152 (Parkville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
